# Shresth Raj — Portfolio

> Animated portfolio of Shresth Raj, a full-stack developer specializing in Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and React.

Shresth Raj is a full-stack developer with experience as a Java trainer at Parul University, freelance backend work on the PropertyManager UAE project (Spring Boot + MySQL), and React development at The Entrepreneurship Network. Skills include Java, JDBC, Hibernate, Spring, Spring Boot, MySQL, Oracle, React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, REST APIs, Git, and DSA.
